inputs.share_count_basis: Fully diluted at 31-Mar-2026: 16,175.3m shares in issue less 48.9m treasury shares held for the RSU scheme = 16,126.4m outstanding, plus 88.5m dilutive options/RSUs from the FY2026 EPS note (2.1m options + 86.3m RSUs) = 16,214.9m. Held FLAT because SBC is fully expensed in the flows; the 80m shares issued to the RSU trust in FY2026 are SBC settlement, not a separate dilution.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2026 annual report, cash flow statement adjustment 'Share-based compensation expenses' RMB162,124k (FY2025 224,535k). No separate cash tax on equity-award settlement is disclosed: awards vest from treasury shares held by the RSU trust, so the add-back is the full figure.
inputs.fx_note: HKD per CNY 1.1721, Yahoo CNYHKD=X at 2026-10-10. Cross-check: USD/HKD 7.8472 / USD/CNY 6.683 = 1.1742 (0.2% tie), confirming direction (1 CNY buys ~1.17 HKD). No dual listing to parity-check against. All flows and the bridge are in CNY millions; per-share values are converted to HKD at this rate for the unsuffixed keys. refresh_price.py does not move this rate - refresh it with the price.

inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in CNY, the currency of the flows: China 10y government bond ~1.9%, equity risk premium ~6.5%, beta ~1.1 for a China consumer-internet/e-pharmacy name => cost of equity ~9.0-9.5%; no debt, so WACC = CoE = 9.5%. Same rate in all three scenarios: China regulatory and Alibaba-related-party risk is carried in the bear flows and its 25% weight, not as a discount-rate premium (risk charged once).
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (B), leases as operating cost: FY2026 lease principal RMB25.0m (financing) plus lease interest RMB1.4m (operating, already inside OCF) charged through lease_cost_pct_path (~0.08% of revenue); D&A path excludes right-of-use depreciation (RMB22.5m); lease liabilities RMB59.8m EXCLUDED from net debt.
inputs.nci_treatment: NCI is immaterial (RMB1.2m equity, RMB0.2m FY2026 profit share); flows treated as fully attributable, no bridge deduction.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF (component route) with the non-US adaptations. Alibaba Health is an operating company - online pharmacy direct sales (B2C retail + B2B distribution, RMB29.7bn of RMB34.3bn FY2026 revenue) plus the Tmall pharmaceutical e-commerce platform and healthcare/digital services - not a bank, REIT or holdco, so the routing table sends it to owner-FCF. First valuation of this ticker (no MEMORY.md entry). OPERATING EBITDA is built from the income statement because the company reports no operating-profit subtotal: gross profit 8,210.1 less fulfilment 2,760.2, selling 2,452.0, admin 373.4, product development 788.3 = 1,836.2 operating profit; + D&A 53.2 (PP&E 14.0, ROU 22.5, intangibles 16.8) + SBC 162.1 = pre-SBC adjusted EBITDA 2,051.5 (5.99% of revenue; FY2025 5.75%, FY2024 3.55%, FY2023 1.27%). 'Other income and gains' (960.5, of which bank interest 463.4, deemed-disposal gains 226.2) and 'other expenses and losses' (523.3, mostly FV losses 415.1 and associate impairments 94.5) are excluded from the flows; their source assets are in the bridge. Recurring operating other income (government grants 55.8, sublease 18.6, JV management fee 11.5) is also left out - a conservative ~RMB86m/yr. INTEREST: of RMB463.4m bank interest income, RMB228.2m was received inside OCF (the rest classified in investing), so owner FCF = 1,227.6 - 162.1 - 228.2 = 837.3 (and 812.3 after the 25.0 lease principal charged in the forward build). FY2025 owner FCF on the same basis 966.8 (1,376.1 - 224.5 - 146.7 - 38.1). WORKING CAPITAL: FY2026 consumed RMB893m (inventory +564, prepayments +428) on a RMB3.66bn revenue increase (-24%); FY2025 -568 on +3.57bn (-16%). Net operating WC is roughly zero (inventory+receivables+prepayments 4.9bn vs payables+contract liabilities+accruals 4.9bn) so capture is modelled modestly negative. BUYBACKS: none in FY2026 (FY2025 RMB39.9m, for RSU settlement) - the flat count is a modelling convention, funded by the SBC charge rather than by repurchases. DIVIDEND: a final (RMB5.95c) plus special (RMB13.52c) dividend totalling RMB3,140m was declared on the FY2026 results and paid 2-Sep-2026 (record date 13-Aug); the price is ex-dividend, so it is deducted in the equity bridge from the March balance-sheet cash. No interim (H1 FY2027, to 30-Sep-2026) results yet - due ~November 2026; the balance sheet is the latest filed. No numeric FY2027 guidance is given in the annual report.
inputs.dividend_policy_note: First-ever dividends (FY2026). The special dividend returned ~24% of gross cash; future special distributions would be value-neutral in this model since cash is already in the bridge.

historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR (4.6% 5yr, 5.6% 3yr) diverges >30% from revenue (17.2% 5yr) and EPS (35.5% 5yr). Equity is distorted by the FY2021 share placement (equity 5.2bn -> 14.3bn) and FY2022 loss; EPS by the move from break-even to profit off a tiny base. Revenue 3yr CAGR (8.6%) chosen as the most representative of the business now; even that overstates the run-rate: H2 FY2026 revenue grew only 7.6% YoY versus 17.0% in H1.
historical_growth.notes: Owner FCF = reported FCF - SBC - interest received in OCF - lease principal. 3yr owner-FCF CAGR undefined (FY2023 negative). Owner-FCF 5yr CAGR (13.5%) EXCEEDS reported FCF CAGR (4.4%) because SBC fell from 2.6% of revenue (FY2021) to 0.47% (FY2026) - the opposite of the usual pattern; less of the growth is being paid for in stock, not more. Reported FCF is volatile on working capital (FY2023 OCF 256 vs FY2024 1,080).

base.rationale: Revenue growth steps down from 12% (FY2026) and the 7.6% H2 run-rate to 7-7.5%, fading to 3% by year 10. Adjusted EBITDA margin anchored at FY2026's 6.0% (the FY2024-26 recovery path 3.6%->5.8%->6.0%) and allowed only 0.5pp more as the platform/advertising mix scales - H2 FY2026 margin actually fell YoY, so no steep ramp. Capex is ~0.03-0.06% of revenue historically; 0.10% with D&A ex-ROU at 0.10% (asset-light, 3P logistics). Cash tax ramps 17% -> 20% (FY2026 tax 338 on operating profit + interest ~2.3bn = 14.7%; blend of 15% HNTE and 25% statutory subsidiaries, carryforward losses now largely used - tax paid tripled to 348). WC capture -18%: growth consumes inventory and prepayments (FY2025-26 average ~-20%).

bull.rationale: Online share of China retail pharmacy keeps rising (ageing population, prescription-drug e-commerce and medical-insurance payment online), growth re-accelerates to 10-11%, and higher-margin platform, advertising and AI/digital services lift adjusted EBITDA to 8%.

bear.rationale: Growth stalls at 3-4% as JD Health, Meituan and PDD compete on price and drug-price controls compress basket values; adjusted EBITDA margin gives back the FY2025-26 gains to 4.5% (between FY2024's 3.6% and FY2025's 5.8%); working capital keeps absorbing a quarter of incremental revenue.

scenario_narratives.base: Alibaba Health is a low-margin pharmaceutical retailer/distributor (direct sales are 87% of revenue at a ~24% gross margin) with a higher-margin Tmall platform layer. The base case says growth normalises to high single digits - the H2 FY2026 slowdown to 7.6% is the new run-rate, not a blip - and operating leverage from fulfilment and selling efficiency is largely banked: the adjusted EBITDA margin edges from 6.0% to 6.5%. On those numbers owner FCF runs ~RMB1.1-1.3bn in the first years, and roughly a quarter of the equity value is the post-dividend net cash and investment book.
scenario_narratives.bull: The bull axes are (1) online penetration of China's retail pharmacy market - prescription drugs and medical-insurance reimbursement online were the structural unlock, and Alibaba Health as Tmall's exclusive pharmacy operator captures a share of it; (2) mix shift to platform commissions, merchant advertising and the 'Hydrion' medical AI/digital-services layer, which carry far higher margins than first-party retail. Growth re-accelerates to 10-11% and margin reaches 8%. Supported by NHSA extending medical-insurance coverage to Internet healthcare, innovative-drug first-launch partnerships (GLP-1s with Innovent, Simcere, Novo Nordisk) and chronic-disease paying users +23% YoY.
scenario_narratives.bear: The bear axes are (1) the May-2026 NMPA Compliance Guidelines for Online Retail of Prescription Drugs - banning AI-based prescription review/renewal and restricting livestream/private-domain marketing of prescription medicines - which constrain the growth playbook of the direct-sales segment (87% of revenue); (2) price competition from JD Health, Ping An Good Doctor, Meituan and O2O pharmacy chains, already visible in a 0.3pp FY2026 gross-margin decline; (3) dependence on Alibaba Group (controlling shareholder) for Tmall/Taobao/Alipay traffic and related-party platform terms. Growth stalls at 3-4%, margins fall back to 4.5%, and working capital keeps absorbing a quarter of incremental revenue. The stock's slide from its 52-week high (HKD7.91, January 2026) through and after the May rules is consistent with the market pricing a path between this and the base.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% house default to 25%: H2 FY2026 revenue growth halved to 7.6% and H2 EBITDA margin fell YoY, the May-2026 NMPA online-prescription rules bite directly on the core segment (single-regulator risk), and the business depends on a controlling shareholder's platform. Bull cut from 35% to 25% because it needs both re-accelerated growth and a mix shift to platform/AI revenue, while the platform segment grew only ~1.4% in FY2026. Base 50%: RMB10bn post-dividend net cash and no debt remove solvency risk.

valuation_philosophy.summary: A net-cash, asset-light e-pharmacy valued on owner FCF: SBC expensed with a flat diluted count, bank interest and investment income stripped from the flows with their source assets (13.2bn cash and deposits, 3.3bn investments) in the bridge, the RMB3.1bn September dividend deducted, and leases charged as an operating cost. Valued in CNY at a CNY-built 9.5% rate and converted to HKD for comparison with the HKEX quote.
key_risks_to_valuation: Growth deceleration: H2 FY2026 revenue +7.6% vs +17.0% in H1; the H1 FY2027 interim (due Nov-2026) is the next test of the base path
Working-capital absorption: inventory and prepayments consumed RMB0.9bn in FY2026; the WC capture assumption moves value materially
Related-party dependence on Alibaba Group (Tmall traffic, platform outsourcing terms)

PRC regulation: May-2026 NMPA online prescription-drug guidelines (AI prescription review banned, livestream marketing restricted); drug-pricing/volume procurement; competition from JD Health, Meituan, Ping An Good Doctor
FX: CNY flows vs HKD quote at a rate refresh_price.py does not update
Investment book (FVTPL 2.3bn, associates 0.7bn) carried at book/fair value; FY2026 already saw RMB415m FV losses and RMB94m impairments
